insight: Launched as Conversion.ai, then Jarvis, before renaming to Jasper in 2022 amid Disney/Marvel trademark concerns over the 'Jarvis' name.
name: Jasper
tagline: AI content platform for marketing teams and brand-consistent campaigns.
description: Jasper is an AI content-generation platform aimed at marketing teams, with a Brand Voice system, campaign workflows, and a library of templates for blogs, ads, and social copy. It layers on top of multiple underlying LLMs and offers a browser extension and API so marketers can generate on-brand content across their existing tools.

modelSupport.notes: Routes across multiple underlying LLMs rather than a single fixed model.

edge: Built around enforced Brand Voice and team campaign workflows rather than one-off copy, so output stays on-brand across channels.
